Hernandez]] | blank1_name = Political party | blank1_info = {{Color box|{{party color|Partido Federal ng Pilipinas}}|border=darkgray}} [[Partido Federal ng Pilipinas|PFP]] | blank2_name = Congressional bloc | blank2_info = Majority }} '''South Cotabato's 2nd congressional district''' is one of the two [[congressional districts of the Philippines]] in the province of [[South Cotabato]]. It has been represented in the [[House of Representatives of the Philippines|House of Representatives]] since 1987.{{cite web|url=http://www.congress.gov.ph/legislators/?v=province |title=Roster of Philippine legislators |publisher=[[House of Representatives of the Philippines]] |accessdate=March 2, 2021}} The district covers the provincial capital city, [[Koronadal]], and two adjacent municipalities, namely [[Banga, South Cotabato|Banga]], and [[Tantangan]].{{cite web|url=https://www.chanrobles.com/ordinance.htm |title=The 1987 Constitution of the Republic of the Philippines |publisher=Chan Robles Virtual Law Library |accessdate=March 2, 2021}} It is currently represented in the [[20th Congress of the Philippines|20th Congress]] by [[Dinand Hernandez|Ferdinand L. Hernandez]] of the [[Partido Federal ng Pilipinas|PFP]].{{cite web |title=House Members |url=https://www.congress.gov.ph/house-members/view/?member=H035&name=Hernandez%2C+Ferdinand+L.&page=0 |accessdate=July 30, 2025 |publisher=[[House of Representatives of the Philippines]]}} Beginning in 2025, Lake Sebu, Norala, Santo Niño, Surallah, and T'boli will be represented under the recreated [[South Cotabato's 3rd congressional district|third district]], pursuant to a 2022 law reapportioning South Cotabato.{{cite PH act|chamber=RA|number=11804| url = https://www.officialgazette.gov.ph/downloads/2022/06jun/20220602-RA-11804-RRD.pdf | title = An Act Reapportioning the Province of South Cotabato Into Three (3) Legislative Districts, and Separating the City of General Santos From the Third Legislative District of the Province of South Cotabato to Constitute the Lone Legislative District of the City of General Santos, Repealing for the Purpose Republic Act No. 11243, Entitled "An Act Reapportioning the First Legislative District of the Province of South Cotabato Thereby Creating the Lone Legislative District of General Santos City" |date=June 2, 2022 | publisher = Official Gazette | access-date = July 27, 2024}} ==Representation history== {| class=wikitable |- ! rowspan="2" | # ! rowspan="2" colspan=2 | Image ! rowspan="2" | Member ! colspan=2 | Term of office ! rowspan="2" | Congress ! rowspan="2" | Party ! rowspan="2" | Electoral history ! rowspan="2" | Constituent
